wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain Napa Valley

note.en: Same Howell Mountain appellation and grape. Dunn is a structured, cellar-oriented reference for mountain Cabernet.
note.zh: 同为豪威尔山赤霞珠。Dunn 单宁结构更强，是偏陈年的山地赤霞珠参考。

comparison.name: Dr. Loosen Red Slate Riesling Dry

note.en: A dry German Riesling reference from the Mosel, with a distinct slate-origin profile.
note.zh: 德国摩泽尔干型雷司令的参考，呈现红板岩产区的特色。

sources.label: Dr. Loosen Red Slate Riesling Dry

note.en: A step up in price within California Cabernet. JUSTIN specifies Paso Robles, a narrower source than the budget label.
note.zh: 同为加州赤霞珠，JUSTIN 价位更高，且明确标示更窄的帕索罗布尔斯产区。

wines.name: Tazmin Breeze New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc

note.en: A benchmark for crisp New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay specifically comes from Marlborough.
note.zh: 同为清爽的新西兰长相思。云雾之湾的产区明确为马尔堡。

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

note.en: A more expensive dry Pinot Grigio benchmark from northern Italy. It shares the grape, with a different regional sourcing.
note.zh: 来自意大利北部的高价干型灰皮诺，同葡萄品种，产区来源另有区别。

wines.name: Reserve Meritage Paso Robles 2023 Red Wine

note.en: A higher-priced Paso Robles Bordeaux-style blend. The blend proportions and oak program are specific to Isosceles.
note.zh: 更高价的帕索罗布尔斯波尔多风格混酿。葡萄配比和用桶方式各有不同。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Blanc de Blancs Napa Valley Sparkling Wine

note.en: A richer California brut sparkling benchmark. Domaine Carneros is a vintage Carneros blend.
note.zh: 风格更丰富的加州干型起泡酒。Domaine Carneros 是标注年份的卡内罗斯混酿。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Brut Rosé Napa Valley Sparkling Wine

comparison.name: Domaine Carneros Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced California brut rosé. This Carneros bottling has its own Pinot Noir-led blend and house style.
note.zh: 价位更高的加州干型桃红起泡酒。这款卡内罗斯的配方以黑皮诺为主，酒庄风格鲜明。

note.en: A premium Sonoma Chardonnay comparison from Russian River Ranches, with a citrus-and-barrel-spice profile.
note.zh: 更高价的索诺玛霞多丽参考，来自俄罗斯河谷酒款系列，呈现柑橘与桶陈香料风味。

wines.name: Compass Bridge Sonoma County Pinot Noir

comparison.name: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir

note.en: A pricier Sonoma Pinot Noir with a narrower coastal appellation.
note.zh: 同为索诺玛黑皮诺，La Crema 来自范围更窄的索诺玛海岸产区，价位更高。

note.en: A more expensive dry Pinot Grigio benchmark from northern Italy. It shares the grape, with a different regional sourcing.
note.zh: 来自意大利北部的高价干型灰皮诺，同葡萄品种，产区来源另有区别。

note.en: A step up in price within California Cabernet. JUSTIN specifies Paso Robles, a narrower source than the budget label.
note.zh: 同为加州赤霞珠，JUSTIN 价位更高，且明确标示更窄的帕索罗布尔斯产区。

wines.name: Henri Laffard Grand Reserve Brut Champagne

comparison.name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Brut Champagne

note.en: A pricier nonvintage Brut Champagne benchmark. The two houses have distinct blend and reserve-wine programs.
note.zh: 同为无年份干型香槟，黄牌香槟价位更高，两家酒庄的调配和基酒风格各有差异。

wines.name: Almond Creek Almond Flavored Sparkling Wine
La Burgondie Cremant De Bourgogne Rose Brut

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle d’Aurore Crémant de Bourgogne Rosé

note.en: Both are Burgundy rosé crémants. Louis Bouillot blends Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Gamay.
note.zh: 同为勃艮第桃红克雷芒起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 混酿黑皮诺、霞多丽和佳美。

wines.name: Charles Shaw Nouveau Red Table Wine 2024

note.en: Both are Carneros Chardonnay. Rombauer is a richer, creamier benchmark for the region.
note.zh: 同为卡内罗斯霞多丽。Rombauer 是酒体更丰厚、口感更绵密的产区参考。

note.en: Both are Langhe Nebbiolo. Perbacco is a more ambitious example with extended maturation.
note.zh: 同为朗格内比奥罗。Perbacco 的熟成较长，可作高价参照。

note.en: Dry Sauvignon Blanc from another Loire appellation. Sancerre gives context for Touraine’s citrus and acidity at a substantially higher price.
note.zh: 同为卢瓦尔河谷干型长相思，桑塞尔来自不同子产区，适合对比图赖讷的柑橘风味和酸度，价位也明显更高。

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.
note.zh: 来自科内利亚诺－瓦尔多比亚德内 DOCG 的高价普罗塞克，花香和梨香鲜明，产区更明确。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle de Vigne Crémant de Bourgogne Brut

note.en: A higher-priced white brut from the same Burgundy crémant appellation.
note.zh: 同属勃艮第克雷芒产区，价位更高的白葡萄干型起泡酒。

wines.name: Hark and Holly Glühwein Mulled Wine

note.en: A premium example of the rich California Chardonnay style. Rombauer is specifically from Carneros.
note.zh: 浓郁型加州霞多丽的高价参考，Rombauer 明确来自卡内罗斯。

wines.name: Tuatea Marlborough New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc

note.en: Both are Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay is a benchmark for more expressive citrus and tropical fruit.
note.zh: 同为马尔堡长相思。云雾之湾可作为柑橘和热带水果香气更浓郁的高价参照。

wines.name: Vin De Bordeaux B by Fonbadet Bordeaux 2019

reputation.en: A budget Bordeaux that drew attention for the Fonbadet name and an approachable red-fruit profile.
reputation.zh: 这款平价波尔多因 Fonbadet 名称和易接受的红色果味而受到关注。

note.en: A higher-tier bottling from Fonbadet. The château wine is Pauillac, while the B bottling uses grapes grown outside that appellation.
note.zh: Fonbadet 旗下更高端的酒款。正牌酒来自波雅克产区，B 酒款则使用该产区以外的葡萄。

rationale.en: Good value for a straightforward Bordeaux, with limited published tasting evidence.
rationale.zh: 作为易饮型波尔多性价比不错，公开品鉴资料有限。

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.
note.zh: 来自科内利亚诺－瓦尔多比亚德内 DOCG 的高价普罗塞克，花香和梨香鲜明，产区更明确。

officialNotes.en: A dry pink sparkler made entirely from Pinot Noir grown in southern France, with berry and floral notes.
officialNotes.zh: 以法国南部的黑皮诺酿造的干型桃红起泡酒，带有浆果和花香。

reputation.en: Known for its ornate bottle and berry-driven style under $10. The Kitchn recommends it, while another tasting found the bubbles faded quickly.
reputation.zh: 以精致的酒瓶、鲜明的浆果风味和不到 10 美元的售价受到关注。《The Kitchn》推荐这款酒，也有试饮者认为气泡消散较快。

comparison.name: Gérard Bertrand Héritage An 825 Crémant de Limoux Brut Rosé

note.en: A more expensive southern French brut rosé to compare. Its blend and traditional-method production offer a different take on the style.
note.zh: 同样来自法国南部的干型桃红起泡酒，价位更高。它采用混酿和传统法，呈现出不同的风格。

rationale.en: Distinctive fruit and strong value, with mixed impressions of the bubbles.
rationale.zh: 果味鲜明、性价比好，气泡表现的评价有分歧。

note.en: A premium white from the Vinho Verde region. The varietal Alvarinho offers a fuller comparison with the light blend.
note.zh: 同来自葡萄牙绿酒产区。单一阿尔瓦里尼奥酒体更丰厚，可与轻盈的混酿对比。

comparison.name: Domaine Carneros Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced California brut rosé. This Carneros bottling has its own Pinot Noir-led blend and house style.
note.zh: 价位更高的加州干型桃红起泡酒。这款卡内罗斯的配方以黑皮诺为主，酒庄风格鲜明。

wines.name: Reserve North Coast Brut Sparkling Wine

note.en: A richer California brut sparkling benchmark. Domaine Carneros is a vintage Carneros blend.

note.en: A higher-priced Prosecco from the Conegliano Valdobbiadene DOCG. Expect a floral, pear-led comparison with clearly specified origin.

officialNotes.en: A crisp Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc with grassy aromatics, bright fruit and tart green-apple character.
officialNotes.zh: 清爽的马尔堡长相思，带有青草香、明亮果味和青苹果般的酸度。

reputation.en: An inexpensive introduction to Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. A tasting of the 2022 highlighted gooseberry, grapefruit and cut grass.
reputation.zh: 适合低预算入门的马尔堡长相思。2022 年份的一篇品鉴记录提到醋栗、葡萄柚和青草香。

note.en: Both are Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay is a benchmark for more expressive citrus and tropical fruit.
note.zh: 同为马尔堡长相思。云雾之湾可作为柑橘和热带水果香气更浓郁的高价参照。

rationale.en: Classic regional character at a good price, based mainly on older tasting evidence.
rationale.zh: 产区特色清晰，价格实惠，评分主要参考较早的品鉴资料。

wines.name: Plat Rsv Cabernet Sauvignon Stags Leap District Napa Valley 2023

comparison.name: Stag’s Leap Wine Cellars FAY Cabernet Sauvignon

note.en: Both are Stags Leap District Cabernet. FAY is a single-vineyard Napa benchmark at a much higher price.
note.zh: 同为纳帕谷鹿跃区赤霞珠。FAY 是价位高得多的单一园代表。

reputation.en: The 2023 Paso Robles Grand Reserve has drawn favorable coverage for delivering a full Bordeaux-style red at a modest price.
reputation.zh: 2023 年帕索罗布尔斯 Grand Reserve 以平实价格提供醇厚的波尔多风格红酒，获得正面品鉴评价。

note.en: A higher-priced Paso Robles Bordeaux-style blend. The blend proportions and oak program are specific to Isosceles.
note.zh: 更高价的帕索罗布尔斯波尔多风格混酿。葡萄配比和用桶方式各有不同。

rationale.en: Substantial regional character and excellent value for a Bordeaux-style blend.
rationale.zh: 产区特色明确，作为波尔多风格混酿性价比突出。

wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Rutherford Napa Valley 2023

officialNotes.en: Rutherford Lot 11. The label identifies Isolated Cellars as the bottler. Trader Joe’s withheld the vineyard name.
officialNotes.zh: 卢瑟福第 11 批次。酒标注明由 Isolated Cellars 装瓶。Trader Joe’s 未公开葡萄园名称。

reputation.en: The 2023 Rutherford bottling is sought out as a $20 entry into a well-known Napa appellation.
reputation.zh: 2023 年份凭借约 20 美元的价格和知名的卢瑟福产区受到关注。

note.en: A higher-priced estate Cabernet from Rutherford. Its fruit comes from a specifically identified estate.
note.zh: 同产区的高价卢瑟福赤霞珠，这款酒明确使用自家庄园葡萄。

rationale.en: A strong price for Rutherford Cabernet and positive published tasting evidence.
rationale.zh: 在卢瑟福赤霞珠中价位较低，有正面的公开品鉴支持。

note.zh: 同为阿罗约塞科霞多丽。Riva Ranch 是来自特定葡萄园、桶陈风味较浓的参考。

wines.name: Reserve Zinfandel Paso Robles Adelaida District 2023 Lot #265

officialNotes.en: A Paso Robles Cabernet with ripe dark fruit and a touch of tobacco in the retailer’s tasting description.
officialNotes.zh: 来自帕索罗布尔斯的赤霞珠。官方品鉴描述提到成熟的深色水果和一丝烟草香。

reputation.en: A soft, fruit-forward Cabernet led by cherry and vanilla. Tastings disagree on how much structure it offers.
reputation.zh: 口感柔和、果味突出的赤霞珠，以樱桃和香草风味为主。不同品鉴者对它的结构感评价不一。

note.en: Also a Paso Robles Cabernet. Hilltop brings firmer structure and extended French-oak aging.
note.zh: 同为帕索罗布尔斯赤霞珠。Hilltop 的结构更扎实，并经过较长时间的法国橡木桶陈年。

rationale.en: Appealing fruit and value, with less tannic grip than some Cabernet drinkers may expect.
rationale.zh: 果味讨喜、性价比好，单宁力度较轻。
